metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for AI agent orchestration, writing, and style analysis

plugins.name: stilwerk
plugins.description: Style analysis, authorship attribution, and text transformation. Combines quantitative stylometry with AI-assisted qualitative analysis.

plugins.name: fusion
plugins.description: Multi-domain AI agent orchestration module for Claude Code. 11 project-agnostic agent profiles (one of them parameterised by domain: code or data) with observation-only hooks that decide nothing and machine-write the bookkeeping — the write trace, the orchestrator event log's dispatch and commit rows with identity on every line, and a configuration advisory when the project's file is broken or retired — plus decision-record tracking, work packages each carrying a brief and an evidence base, whose prerequisites are proposed for the user's approval and, once declared, reported back as depth, topological order, readiness and cycles, a state-auditor whose audit result says whether tracking files match the tree, incremental cleanup off per-checkout anchors, a message one checkout leaves for the next, read with /fusion:news before a pull, a bounded discussion the user opens with /fusion:discuss between the agent they already talk to and the consultant, each claim coming back checked, refuted or not decidable and the exchange recorded from the first round, a policy-curator that reconciles decision records, rule files and CLAUDE.md against the project's recorded history, and a real-time browser monitor with session-scoped ETA estimation. /fusion:help inside Claude Code explains every workflow.

plugins.name: flight
plugins.description: Lightweight AI work companion for non-technical users. One general-purpose agent (pilot) for analyzing documents, discussing topics, and producing precise, well-styled written outputs. Includes session-close compaction, open-task tracking via CLAUDE.md, and built-in professional-voice and chat-voice style guides (English + German). /flight:help inside Claude Code for self-explainer. Dispatch with `claude --agent flight:pilot`.
